description:
GOD CHANGED HER STORY is A Powerful Nigerian Inspirational Movie | 
LESOSTUDIO 
‎
‎Amara is a young woman who refuses to give up, even when life seems determined to break her. While her friends enjoy wealth, comfort and seemingly perfect lives, Amara struggles with poverty, loneliness and unanswered prayers. Her friends mock her because she is unmarried, struggling financially and has nothing to show for her efforts.
‎
‎But Amara refuses to let their words define her future.
‎
‎With faith in God, courage, hard work and determination, she takes a small step towards changing her life. What begins as a humble food business gradually opens doors she never imagined possible.
‎
‎Will Amara's faith finally pay off? Will the people who laughed at her regret underestimating her?
‎
‎this is an emotional Nigerian inspirational movie about patience, perseverance, friendship, betrayal, hope, hard work and God's timing. It reminds us that a difficult beginning does not mean a hopeless future.
‎
‎Watch until the end and discover why you should never give up on your dreams.
